<thought>Based on the provided fragments—benzene ring (c1ccccc1), an acid chloride group (C(=O)Cl), and a methyl group (C)—the most straightforward way to represent the whole molecule is to attach the acid chloride to the benzene and then attach the methyl to the carbonyl carbon. This yields the SMILES string “c1ccccc1C(=O)ClC”.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1C(=O)ClC</final_answer>
